respuesta.razonamiento: The whiteboard shows the Atlassian Forge platform architecture divided into two distinct flows: deployment and execution across an account boundary. The deployment flow starts with a developer using the CLI to send code to an EC2 web service, which records deployment progress in DynamoDB and enqueues deployment jobs into SQS. Another backend EC2 service reads from SQS to rate-limit Lambda creations and deploys multi-tenant Lambda functions (running V8 isolates) into a dedicated customer code AWS account. The execution/invocation flow starts from a browser user making requests to an internal EC2 invocation service, which handles authentication/permissions and invokes the corresponding Lambda function across the account boundary.
